normalization_plan.reason: param_from is the source argument of the _transfer function and carries no independent identity
param_to is the destination argument of _transfer and should be folded into the function node
param_amount is the value argument of _transfer feeding fee and limit math
param_newMarketingWallet is the sole argument assigned inside updateMarketingWallet
param_newWallet is the sole argument assigned inside updateDevWallet
local_contractBalance is an internal temporary of swapBack used only for its swap computation
local_totalTokensToSwap is an internal temporary divisor of swapBack
param_newAmount is the argument validated and stored by updateSwapTokensAtAmount
